entities.name: Bulp
entities.description: A large, thoughtful goblin of Dominaria and ward of King Squee.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: The immortal goblin leader who took Bulp under his wing.

entities.name: Rarp
entities.description: A goblin who was turned into a Phyrexian sleeper agent.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: A corrupted Ertai who assumed Bulp's form before revealing himself to Squee.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where Bulp and Squee live.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The Phyrexian menace, thought defeated, resurfacing through sleeper agents.

events.summary: Bulp brings Squee news that Rarp was crushed under a boulder at the mountain home entrance.
events.quote: a fellow goblin, had been crushed under a boulder at the entrance to their mountain home

events.summary: Squee and Bulp discover Rarp is alive and leaking black oil, a Phyrexian sleeper agent.
events.quote: indicating that he had been turned into a Phyrexian sleeper agent

events.summary: Squee sends Bulp to warn the outside world; Bulp reaches a human town and reports the Phyrexian resurgence.
events.quote: Bulp boldly ventured forth to warn the nearby villages of this threat

events.summary: The corrupted Ertai takes Bulp's form, then reveals himself to Squee, who believes Bulp dead.
events.quote: the corrupted Ertai had assumed Bulp's form briefly, before revealing his true self to Squee

events.summary: An accidental explosion caused by Squee destroys the mountain and his Phyrexian kingdom; Bulp returns and is reunited with Squee.
events.quote: wiping out his entire Phyrexian kingdom in the process
